gitCommit.subject: Report App Store subscription transfers instead of ignoring them
gitCommit.body:
Report App Store subscription transfers instead of ignoring them

RevenueCat sends TRANSFER when one Apple ID's subscription moves to a different
Vittio account — the same person signing up again after deleting their account,
or restoring onto a second one. The type was not in HANDLED_TYPES, so it was
acknowledged and dropped: the new account got nothing and nobody found out.

Deliberately hand-operated rather than automatic. The payload carries only the
two id lists — no product, no expiry, no price — so granting access to the new
owner would mean asking RevenueCat what they now own: an API client, a secret
key, and an outbound call. That is not worth its maintenance at this frequency.
An alert plus a one-minute manual move is the better trade.

The previous account keeps its access on purpose. It is normally the same human,
and revoking would take away what they paid for while granting nothing back.
